analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Modernize a legacy VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring functionality is documented, rewritten, and tested in a Docker environment.
requirements_understanding: The legacy codebase is a VB6 banking application with various forms and ActiveX dependencies.
Modernization involves translating the application into C# while maintaining existing functionality.
The project requires documentation of current functionality, design of new architecture, implementation, and testing.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Use C# for rewriting the legacy VB6 code.
Implement Docker for local testing environments.
Ensure backward compatibility with existing business logic and workflows.
clarifications_requested: Are there any specific changes to the business logic that need to be implemented during modernization?
What are the specific security requirements for the modernized application?

output.executive_summary: The project aims to modernize a VB6 banking application to C#, ensuring functionality is preserved and tested in a Docker environment.

functional_requirements.title: Document Current Functionality
functional_requirements.description: Create comprehensive documentation of the existing VB6 application's functionality, including inputs, outputs, and side effects.
acceptance_criteria: Documentation includes all forms and controls with their respective functionalities.
All ActiveX and DLL dependencies are documented with their purposes.
Business rules and workflows are clearly outlined.

functional_requirements.title: Design New Architecture
functional_requirements.description: Design a new architecture for the application in C#, ensuring it supports all documented functionalities.
acceptance_criteria: Architecture design is reviewed and approved by the technical team.
Design includes data flow diagrams and component interactions.
Architecture supports scalability and maintainability.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Rewritten Services
functional_requirements.description: Rewrite the VB6 application services in C#, ensuring they match the documented functionality.
acceptance_criteria: All services are implemented in C# and pass unit tests.
Services maintain the same input/output contracts as the legacy system.
Backward compatibility with existing data structures is ensured.

functional_requirements.title: Run QA/Security Checks
functional_requirements.description: Conduct quality assurance and security checks on the rewritten application to ensure it meets all requirements.
acceptance_criteria: All critical security vulnerabilities are identified and mitigated.
QA tests cover all documented functionalities and pass successfully.
Security checks are documented and reviewed by the security team.

functional_requirements.title: Validate Requirements
functional_requirements.description: Validate that the modernized application meets all documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: All functional requirements are validated against the acceptance criteria.
Stakeholder sign-off is obtained for all validated requirements.
Validation results are documented and archived.

functional_requirements.title: Deploy for Local Docker Testing
functional_requirements.description: Deploy the modernized application in a local Docker environment for testing.
acceptance_criteria: Application is successfully deployed in a Docker container.
All services run without errors in the Docker environment.
Deployment process is documented and reproducible.

functional_requirements.title: Maintain Backward Compatibility
functional_requirements.description: Ensure the modernized application maintains backward compatibility with existing data and workflows.
acceptance_criteria: All legacy data can be processed by the new application without errors.
Existing workflows are preserved in the modernized application.
Backward compatibility is verified through integration tests.

functional_requirements.title: Integrate ActiveX and DLL Dependencies
functional_requirements.description: Integrate necessary ActiveX and DLL dependencies into the modernized C# application.
acceptance_criteria: All required dependencies are integrated and functional in the C# application.
Dependency integration does not introduce new security vulnerabilities.
Integration is documented with clear instructions for future maintenance.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance Optimization
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the modernized application performs efficiently under expected load conditions.

acceptance_criteria: Performance tests confirm response times under 2 seconds for 95% of requests.
